purpose: Qualitative demand/friction intelligence for the single Stödassistenten learning system. These scores are not measured search volumes and do not prove eligibility or factual truth. Community discussion is discovery-only; work-injury dental-cost facts must be verified against current Försäkringskassan primary sources, while possible Afa coverage must be verified separately against current Afa/collective-agreement sources.

scoring.priority_rule: Prioritize combinations of high demand, high friction, high consequence and weak current product coverage. Scores are qualitative prioritization, not measured search volume.

skadade tanden på väg hem från jobbet försäkringskassan eller jobbets försäkring
arbetsskada tandläkare kostnadsförslag vilken ersättning ska jag söka
måste arbetsskadan vara godkänd innan jag kan söka ersättning för tanden

demand_signal.basis: Public questions repeatedly frame work injuries as 'who pays' or 'which insurance applies', including commute injuries and dental costs. This is qualitative discovery only, not measured search volume.

friction_signal.basis: The user must distinguish reporting an incident from a benefit decision, Försäkringskassan dental-cost reimbursement from ordinary dental support, and any separate Afa/collective-agreement insurance. Reference-price limits add another easy-to-miss boundary.

miss_consequence.basis: A missed or confused route can leave a person with substantial dental costs, missing evidence, or an incorrect assumption that an employer report or another insurer automatically settles the Försäkringskassan claim.

source_fragmentation.basis: Försäkringskassan governs the specific dental-cost reimbursement route, while separate collective-agreement work-injury compensation may exist through Afa. The two routes must not be merged into one eligibility decision.

language_accessibility_friction.basis: Natural wording is about an accident, tooth damage, commute, employer or insurance rather than the formal name of the reimbursement. Users may not know the difference between work-injury reporting and applying for a specific cost benefit.

steps_to_action.basis: The person needs to establish work/commute connection, treatment necessity, cost documentation and dentist connection before the safe application step, then separately check any collective-agreement insurance without assuming coverage.

recurrence_signal.basis: The same routing confusion recurs across accidents at work, commuting injuries, dental trauma and questions about employer versus public or collective-agreement insurance.

current_product_coverage_gap.basis: The repository has broad sickness/work and dental paths but no structured work-injury dental reimbursement record or permanent scenario covering the boundary between Försäkringskassan and separate collective-agreement insurance.

signals.recommended_learning_action: Add a review-gated Försäkringskassan work-injury dental-cost truth record and permanent synthetic regression first. Then expose a bounded same-shell route that asks only causal/treatment/document facts that can change the path, keeps Afa/collective-agreement insurance separate, and never treats incident reporting as benefit approval.
signals.truth_rule: Discovery discussions reveal wording and friction only. Verify work/commute causation, treatment necessity, cost evidence, dentist connection, reference-price and application facts against the current Försäkringskassan primary source. Verify any Afa/collective-agreement route separately and never infer coverage from union membership or employment alone. Do not promote the new support record from NEEDS_REVIEW to VERIFIED without the required human review chain.
